description: PARIS·GUEST·HOME™ presents:Ideally located in the heart of Paris (a 5-minute walk to Opéra, 20 minutes to the Louvre, and just 15 minutes to the Champs-Élysées and Eiffel Tower by public transport), this beautiful, quintessential Haussmannian building offers the perfect base for exploring the cityThis fully equipped, typically Parisian apartment provides all the comforts of a luxury hotel, ensuring an exceptional and authentic Parisian experience—whether for a weekend getaway or a longer stayThe spaceThe apartment is located on the second floor of a beautiful freestone Haussmannian building, accessible via a wide and easily manageable staircase with a handrail. Please note, there is no elevator, so the apartment is unfortunately not suitable for guests with reduced mobility. For our American guests, the second floor is equivalent to the third floor, meaning there are two flights of stairs to climb. The entrance door is marked with a brass plaque, displaying the number 202 at the bottom.This elegant apartment consists of an entrance hall, a spacious living and dining area with an open kitchen, two master bedrooms each with their own en-suite bathrooms, a laundry room, and a guest lavatory.While offering all modern comforts, the apartment preserves its original charm with moldings, woodwork, floral cast-iron radiators, original doors and handles, and its classic 19th-century herringbone parquet flooring.The apartment is strictly non-smoking, and parties are strictly prohibited. Only the guests listed in the reservation are permitted in the apartment. During your stay, it is not allowed to use additional beds (such as the sofa bed) unless they have been included in the booking. If you wish to use extra beds, you must book for the correct number of occupants. The apartment
